modelVerification: explicit invocation only; CLI did not echo model

findings.message: Record lastCheckpointGC only after successful cleanup. Advancing it before GC means listing or deletion failures prevent another attempt until the configured interval has elapsed since this attempt. Restore error propagation and update the timestamp only on success.
findings.evidence: recommender.go:158-160 checks the interval, advances lastCheckpointGC, then calls GC unconditionally. cluster_feeder.go:294-310 logs listing failures and returns; :323-325 logs deletion failures and continues without reporting failure to the caller. config.go:116 defaults the interval to ten minutes. CHANGE.diff shows the previous implementation advanced the timestamp only when GC returned no error.

findings.message: Give GC an independently started timeout after checkpoint writing finishes. The shared deadline lets writing consume GC's entire budget, so due cleanup can start with an expired context. Create separate write and GC contexts from the parent context.
findings.evidence: recommender.go:190-192 creates the write deadline before MaintainCheckpoints; :156 and :160 pass the same context sequentially to writing and GC. checkpoint_writer.go:115-118 checks cancellation after processing a VPA, and :134 waits for workers, so writing can return after expiry. cluster_feeder.go:323 passes that potentially expired context to checkpoint Delete. CHANGE.diff shows the previous GC timeout started after writing returned.

result.coverage: Verified both existing findings against TASK.json, CHANGE.diff, staged maintenance and GC implementations, checkpoint writer cancellation, configuration wiring, and the controller's RunOnce caller. Retained two distinct contract violations. Moving the write deadline immediately before MaintainCheckpoints preserves its effective start point for the supplied caller.
limitations: Read-only source inspection; no tests were run.
Generated clients and checkpoint API helpers are not supplied, so exact request cancellation behavior and operational frequency of failures remain unverified.
result.contribution: Reconfirmed both defects from source and qualified their consequences: retry suppression is measured from the attempted GC timestamp, and the timeout finding establishes an expired context reaching Delete without asserting verified API cancellation or permanent cleanup starvation.
